content:
olivia_recruiter: Quick ask — we have a Sr SWE candidate (Sasha G) for a panel loop next week. Proposed: Wed Mar 18 10:00am PT. Need confirmations + rubric Qs. @alex @maria_poole @sam_l @kevin_dev
alex: I can do 10:00 PT, though 11:00 PT is slightly better for me. Either works if others are set.
maria_poole: 10:00 PT works for me. I'm blocked 11–12 so prefer 10.
sam_l: I can't do Wed morning — travel. I'm free Wed 2pm or Thu. If someone can cover my slot I'm happy to review notes.
kevin_dev: I can cover system-design and volunteer to run debrief if needed.
olivia_recruiter: Thanks — if Sam is OOO, @maria_poole can we swap so panel is [alex, maria_poole, kevin_dev]? Also one rubric clarification: do we use the 6/4 senior weighting (tech/impact) or the default 5/5? Link: https://docs.redwood.com/hiring/rubric
maria_poole: Use 6/4 for Sr ICs per our last calibration. Also please fill the "communication" free-text field — it's required for passing to hiring manager.
alex: +1 to 6/4. For process: primary interviewer fills initial scores in 24h, then 20–30m debrief. Who will be primary?
kevin_dev: I'll be primary for system-design. If Alex can take coding/behavior, that covers it for me.
olivia_recruiter: Perfect. I'll assign primary roles in the calendar invite. Draft event (I'll paste into invites):
```
Event: Sasha G — Sr SWE loop
Time: Wed Mar 18 10:00 PT
Interviewers: alex (coding/behavior), maria_poole (frontend/ownership), kevin_dev (system design)
Debrief: Wed Mar 18 11:15 PT (30m) — lead: kevin_dev
Prep: read resume + 3 prompt examples attached
Scorecard: https://tiny.redwood/scorecard-sasha
```
alex: Looks good. Should we remind interviewers to use the "confidence" checkbox (low/med/high)? We've had missing confidence notes recently.
maria_poole: Yes please — include in invite description. Also ask interviewers to paste 1–2 strengths/risks in chat during debrief.
recruiting-bot: Reminder scheduled — please complete scorecard within 24 hours of interview. Use `/scorecard fill SashaG` to open the form. :calendar:
olivia_recruiter: Thanks — I'll send invites now and set the debrief for 11:15 PT. Action items: I will send invites, kevin_dev is debrief lead, alex primary on coding, everyone please complete scorecard within 24h. Any objections?
sam_l: No objections. I'll catch the debrief notes async if I miss live.
kevin_dev: All good from me. I'll prepare 3 system-design prompts (15m) and a quick scoring rubric note for the debrief.
olivia_recruiter: Great — closing this thread. I'll post the calendar and the candidate prep sheet once sent. :thumbsup:
